messages:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up: the midnight spike traced to a tokenizer + quant path that only reproduces under bursty prompt mixes. We need ownerable evals and short timelines.

alex: Proposed work items: 1) a small reproducible prompt-set, 2) a nightly regression job that runs bursts, 3) a chaos drill for fallback loops, 4) CI gate to catch regressions.

lia: I'll assemble the prompt-set (50 samples) that mimic customer short Q/A, code, unicode, and malformed tokens. Draft samples: ["Invoice total?", "Fix: nil cache", "Translate: unexpected token"]. Target PR: Fri EOD.

jonathan: I'll add a burst profile runner: 2k RPS bursts for 30m at 03:00 UTC, capture p95/p99 and error-rate, and add dashboard panels. Also own the chaos drill to force fallback from model-A to quant-B and observe autoscaler. ETA: next Tue for drill + runbook.

alex: For CI: fail on quality drop >1.5% on the regression prompts or tail latency increase >25%. I'll add a named eval gate: token_q_reg_v1. DUE: next Wed.

maria: Ownership summary: lia -> prompt-set + unit eval PR (DUE: Fri), alex -> CI gate & tagging for Optimize ingestion (DUE: Wed), jonathan -> burst job + chaos drill + dashboards (DUE: Tue). I'll coordinate monitoring and alerts.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-035 created: "tokenizer-quant mismatch under burst". Action items added to tracker.

maria: Please post PR links and blockers here. After two clean nightly runs we'll mark monitoring complete. :thumbsup:
